themes.name: Kura Shizuku
themes.description: A quiet-luxury theme for small sake breweries and tasting rooms that sell bottles, gift sets and brewery goods online. Every page is composed like a sake bottle label: centred and symmetric, framed by fine double gilt hairlines, with a single drop as the recurring mark, small spaced capitals and a lot of calm space. Rice-polish ivory, koji beige, aged cedar brown, sake-lees grey and a restrained gilded gold, EB Garamond with a gold italic for titles and Albert Sans for text, slow drip-and-ripple reveals that stop under reduced motion. Includes a brewery page with the process, the brewing year and tours, a tasting room page with flights and booking information, a newsletter and contact page with a map, a responsible-drinking note in the footer, and WooCommerce shop, product, cart, checkout and account templates styled to match.

themes.name: Seiji Utsuwa
themes.description: A sculptural, gallery-like theme for small online shops of handmade Japanese tableware: celadon bowls, plates, cups and vases from a few small kilns, shown like a museum room. Every object stands on a porcelain plinth with a soft shadow, pictures sit in arches and rounded glaze-pool shapes, catalogue numbers and hairline labels sit under each piece, and there is generous air around everything. Celadon mist, pale celadon, deep kiln teal, unglazed clay and iron-black ink, Brygada 1918 with a celadon italic for titles and Hanken Grotesk for text, slow fade-and-rise reveals and a subtle parallax that stop under reduced motion. Includes a kilns page with a map and maker profiles, a care guide with a material chart and repair notes, a newsletter and a viewing-room contact page, and WooCommerce shop, product, cart, checkout and account templates styled to match.
